top_signals.title: Warsh’s ‘Forward Silence’ Risks Bigger Treasury Market Swings
top_signals.summary: Investors are worried that Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh’s plan to reduce the number of interest-rate decisions each year could be a recipe for more volatility in the $32 trillion Treasury market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Tokenization Gives Illiquid Funds a 24/7 Trading Twist
top_signals.summary: Putting interval funds on the blockchain could change more than just how their shares trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Cyberattack disrupts Belgian tax services before filing deadline
top_signals.summary: The Federal Public Service Finance (FPS Finance), which oversees taxation and other financial administration, said Wednesday that it was investigating the extent of the attack and had temporarily suspended access to MyMinfin, the country's main online platform for managing tax and financial affairs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Venezuela’s Rodríguez Vows to Hold Election; Machado Asks When
top_signals.summary: Venezuela’s acting president pledged to hold elections once the agency that oversees voting is overhauled, offering her most specific vision yet for restoring democracy even as the nation’s leading opposition figure pressed her to commit to a date next year.

top_signals.title: University of New Mexico restores hospital systems, urges no contact with hackers
top_signals.summary: The University of New Mexico was able to restore systems used by its healthcare facilities after a cyberattack forced it to divert ambulances and cancel classes at its medical school.
